title: Board Meeting
summary_markdown:
## Meeting Purpose

[Introduce the AI solution's reference section and its value.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=21.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Goal:** Use AI to automate repetitive manual work, speeding up processes and improving efficiency.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=42.0)
  - [**Mechanism:** A simple UI takes user input, which an AI processes to generate a relevant response or action.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=52.0)
  - [**Value Prop:** Reduces manual work, improves response time, and enhances user experience by making information more accessible.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)
  - [**Status:** A core functionality demo is ready, proving AI can be integrated into workflows, not just used as a chatbot.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)

## Topics

### AI Solution Overview

  - [**Objective:** Use AI to simplify tasks requiring manual effort → faster, more efficient processes.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=42.0)
  - [**Mechanism:**](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=52.0)
      - [Simple user interface for input.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=52.0)
      - [AI processes input to generate a relevant response or action.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=52.0)
      - [Example: System understands a request about "number system" and provides a corresponding response.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=76.0)
  - [**Business Value:**](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)
      - [Reduce repetitive manual work.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)
      - [Improve response times.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)
      - [Increase information accessibility.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)
      - [Create a smoother end-user experience.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=95.0)

### Current Status & Path Forward

  - [**Current State:** A core functionality demo is ready.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
      - [**Significance:** Proves AI can be integrated into workflows, not just used as a chatbot.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
  - [**Areas for Improvement:**](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
      - [Accuracy](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
      - [Speed](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)
      - [Overall User Experience](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=118.0)

## Next Steps

  - [**Alex:** Present the project budget in the next session.](https://fathom.video/share/j2LU-yVfEstxX8BxTv7z9isYCmiTS2iM?tab=summary&timestamp=140.0)
